Filled trapezoid connecting two tracks

Source: R/seq_synteny.R
seq_synteny.Rd

Draws a filled quadrilateral whose bottom edge spans a region in track t0 and whose top edge spans a homologous region in track t1. Use to highlight syntenic blocks, orthologous segments, or otherwise paired intervals across two stacked tracks.

Usage

seq_synteny(
  data = NULL,
  mapping = NULL,
  t0 = NULL,
  t1 = NULL,
  aesthetics = aes(),
  height = NULL,
  smooth = FALSE,
  layer = c("above", "below"),
  ...
)

Arguments

data

Optional GRanges or data.frame.

mapping

Optional map().

t0, t1

Track identifiers. Locked to the parent track when added inside a seq_track().

aesthetics

Optional aes(): fill / color (fill color), alpha (default 0.4), linewidth (border width).

height

Optional block height as a fraction of the panel inner height. NULL (default) anchors at the panel edges.

smooth

Logical. Smoothstep sides instead of straight ones.

layer

"above" (default) draws after track elements; "below" draws before them, so ribbons sit beneath blocks.

...

Reserved.

Value

A SeqSyntenyR6 instance.

Details

data may be a GRanges or a data.frame. Required map() fields are x0 and x1; x0_end and x1_end default to one base past x0/x1 when absent. Numeric edges are used exactly (no rounding to whole bases). y0 and y1 default to the bottom edge of t0's inner panel and the top edge of t1's inner panel respectively — no scale conversion is applied in that case. With height set, the defaults become the facing edges of blocks of that height centred in each panel (the same geometry as seq_block() and seq_connector()).

The optional logical map() field twisted pairs x0 with x1_end and x0_end with x1, so the two sides cross (an inverted copy). With smooth = TRUE each side follows a smoothstep curve (16 points per side), which turns twisted ribbons into S shapes.
